    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">全网都在找的Nano Banana Pro API 来了！便宜稳定0.15/张</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-0"><span data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-0">Nano Banana Pro<span data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-1">（Gemini 3 Pro Image）<span data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-2">是Google基于Gemini 3 Pro开发的新一代图像生成与编辑模型，它不仅在图像质量上达到了新的高度，更在<span data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-3">文字渲染、多图像融合和实时信息整合<span data-offset-key="fbi7g-0-4">方面带来了突破性的进展。</span></span></span></span></span></div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="c3v3c-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="c3v3c-0-0"><span data-offset-key="c3v3c-0-0">本文将带你全面了解它的能力，并快速上手Nano Banana Pro API 接入教程。</span></div>
</div>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="b1a0s-0-0"><span data-offset-key="b1a0s-0-0">一、Nano Banana Pro有哪些提升？</span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="9nb7c-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="9nb7c-0-0"><span data-offset-key="9nb7c-0-0">Nano Banana Pro（官方名称为Gemini 3 Pro Image）可不是普通的图像生成器，它是一个具备<span data-offset-key="9nb7c-0-1">先进推理能力和场景理解<span data-offset-key="9nb7c-0-2">的创意生产工具。</span></span></span></div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="6hj44-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="6hj44-0-0"><span data-offset-key="6hj44-0-0">在 Gemini 3 Pro 的基础上，它在以下几个方面进行了改进：</span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="emf0g-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="emf0g-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="emf0g-0-0"><span data-offset-key="emf0g-0-0">高保真度和控制：<span data-offset-key="emf0g-0-1">准确反映光照、景深和摄像机角度等物理参数，并可控制各种宽高比，从 9:16 竖版海报到 21:9 电影广角镜头。</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="entba-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="entba-0-0"><span data-offset-key="entba-0-0">文字渲染：<span data-offset-key="entba-0-1">准确地在图像中拼写文字，并将文字无缝集成到徽标、标牌和产品包装中。</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="5bbo6-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="5bbo6-0-0"><span data-offset-key="5bbo6-0-0">基于事实的生成：<span data-offset-key="5bbo6-0-1">以谷歌搜索为基础，生成准确的信息图和插图。</span></span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="fnj00-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="fnj00-0-0"><span data-offset-key="fnj00-0-0">它通过“场景感知”和“区域特定编辑”等技术，让创作者能通过自然语言与AI进行高效协作。解决了上一代Nano banana的痛点：<span data-offset-key="fnj00-0-1">清晰度低、文字渲染错误不支持多语言、参考图数量有限、推理与世界知识弱、比例少<span data-offset-key="fnj00-0-2">等问题。</span></span></span></div>
</div>
<div class="Image-captionContainer" data-size="normal">
<div>
<div class="Image-resizerContainer css-ym3v7r" data-size="normal">
<div class="css-79elbk">

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="fij6m-0-0"><span data-offset-key="fij6m-0-0">二、ano Banana Pro四大升级</span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="ajesr-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="ajesr-0-0"><span data-offset-key="ajesr-0-0">Nano Banana Pro的强大功能可以归纳为以下几个关键方面：</span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="6aam2-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="6aam2-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="6aam2-0-0"><span data-offset-key="6aam2-0-0">卓越的文字渲染能力<span data-offset-key="6aam2-0-1">：这是它最引人注目的突破。无论是中文、英文还是其他语言，无论是特定字体还是手写风格，它都能在图像中生成<span data-offset-key="6aam2-0-2">清晰、准确且风格匹配的文字<span data-offset-key="6aam2-0-3">。这意味着你可以直接生成高质量的海报、信息图，甚至漫画对话。</span></span></span></span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="Image-captionContainer" data-size="normal">
<div>
<div class="Image-resizerContainer css-ym3v7r" data-size="normal">

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="5e9mi-0-0"><span data-offset-key="5e9mi-0-0">实时搜索获取世界知识<span data-offset-key="5e9mi-0-1">：Gemini 3 Pro Image 连接庞大的知识库，借助它的强大推理能力和对 Google 搜索实时信息的接入，Nano Banana Pro 不仅能生成精美图像，还能创造真正有用的视觉内容。它可以瞬间生成准确的教育示意图、包含丰富上下文的信息图表，甚至直接把真实世界的事实变成可视化内容。</span></span></div>
</li>
</ul>

</li>
</ul>

</li>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="bk2hb-0-0"><span data-offset-key="bk2hb-0-0">三、Nano Banana Pro怎么使用？</span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="fpn0p-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="fpn0p-0-0"><span data-offset-key="fpn0p-0-0">打开 gemini.google.com 或 Gemini 移动应用。</span></div>
</div>

<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="7b2g1-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="7b2g1-0-0"><span data-offset-key="7b2g1-0-0">pro目前不是纯免费，需要付费使用。但是在Nano Banana Pro在限速前，每个人都能免费生成50-100张图。用完之后系统会自动切换到Gemini 2.5 Flash继续使用。如果你发现次数用完了，不妨试试切换设备，说不定次数又回来了。</span></div>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="a2qqv-0-0"><span data-offset-key="a2qqv-0-0">四、如何调用Nano Banana Pro API</span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="evcck-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="evcck-0-0"><span data-offset-key="evcck-0-0">Nano Banana Pro提供了多种接入方式，你可以根据自己的预算需求选择渠道。</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="9mdpp-0-0"><span data-offset-key="9mdpp-0-0">Google API调用攻略</span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="drpa3-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="drpa3-0-0"><span data-offset-key="drpa3-0-0">Nano Banana Pro（模型 ID：gemini-3-pro-image-preview）官方一张图0.134美元，折算成人民币0.953/张图，价格偏高不适合中小型企业。</span></div>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="b2jsp-0-0"><span data-offset-key="b2jsp-0-0">1. 获取 API Key</span></div>
</div>
<ol class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ol" data-offset-key="a81d3-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-orderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="a81d3-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="a81d3-0-0"><span data-offset-key="a81d3-0-0">打开 Google AI Studio<span data-offset-key="a81d3-2-0">（<a class="Link ztext-link" href="https://aistudio.google.com/" target="_blank" data-offset-key="a81d3-3-0" data-editable="true" data-draft-title="https://aistudio.google.com/" rel="noopener nofollow">https://aistudio.google.com/</a><span data-offset-key="a81d3-4-0">）</span></span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-orderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="c6f0d-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="c6f0d-0-0"><span data-offset-key="c6f0d-0-0">登录 Google 账号</span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-orderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="c9ppk-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="c9ppk-0-0"><span data-offset-key="c9ppk-0-0">左侧菜单 → “Get API key” → 创建新 key（或直接复制现有）</span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-orderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="7qf8c-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="7qf8c-0-0"><span data-offset-key="7qf8c-0-0">（可选）在项目中启用计费（Billing），否则高额度调用会失败</span></div>
</li>
</ol>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="3rcoq-0-0"><span data-offset-key="3rcoq-0-0">2. 官方模型名称与 Endpoint</span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="3mtci-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="3mtci-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="3mtci-0-0"><span data-offset-key="3mtci-0-0">快速版（旧 Nano Banana）<span data-offset-key="3mtci-0-1">：gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="dnkbv-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="dnkbv-0-0"><span data-offset-key="dnkbv-0-0">Pro 版（Nano Banana Pro）<span data-offset-key="dnkbv-0-1">：gemini-3-pro-image-preview（推荐）</span></span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="2huar-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="2huar-0-0"><span data-offset-key="2huar-0-0">Endpoint（统一用 generateContent）： </span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="55gn9-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>POST https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/{model_name}:generateContent?key=YOUR_API_KEY</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="48eem-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="48eem-0-0"><span data-offset-key="48eem-0-0">3. 基本调用示例（Python SDK 推荐，最简单）</span></div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="9h3pn-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="9h3pn-0-0"><span data-offset-key="9h3pn-0-0">安装官方 SDK：</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="ecunk-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install -U google-generativeai</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="7qscg-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="7qscg-0-0"><span data-offset-key="7qscg-0-0">开始调用</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="cdh3m-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import google.generativeai as genai
import os

genai.configure(api_key</span>="YOUR_API_KEY"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

model </span>= genai.GenerativeModel("gemini-3-pro-image-preview"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)  # Nano Banana Pro

response </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.generate_content(
    </span>"一张赛博朋克风格的东京夜景，霓虹灯上写着中文‘纳米香蕉 Pro’，超高清，电影感"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    generation_config</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
        </span>"response_mime_type": "application/json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,  # 返回 JSON，包含图像 base64
    }
)

# 保存图像
import json, base64
data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.loads(response.text)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">with</span> open("output.png", "wb"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(data[</span>"candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["inline_data"]["data"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]))

print(</span>"生成完成！")</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="3nh2j-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="3nh2j-0-0"><span data-offset-key="3nh2j-0-0">&nbsp;</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="6339b-0-0"><span data-offset-key="6339b-0-0">国内直连APi供应商——<a class="Link ztext-link" href="https://grsai.com/" target="_blank" data-offset-key="6339b-1-0" data-editable="true" data-draft-title="GrsAi Api" rel="noopener nofollow">GrsAi Api</a><span data-offset-key="6339b-2-0">调用攻略</span></span></div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="e13l9-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="e13l9-0-0"><span data-offset-key="e13l9-0-0">GrsAI（<a class="Link ztext-link" href="https://grsai.com/" target="_blank" data-offset-key="e13l9-1-0" data-editable="true" data-draft-title="https://grsai.com" rel="noopener nofollow">https://grsai.com</a><span data-offset-key="e13l9-2-0">）作为国内APi直连供应商，提供便宜稳定的Nano Banana pro 直连0.15/张图，比官方价格<span data-offset-key="e13l9-2-1">便宜了将近84%（Google-<span data-offset-key="e13l9-2-2">0.935 rmb<span data-offset-key="e13l9-2-3">）<span data-offset-key="e13l9-2-4">。目前GrsAI站内还可以低价调用Nano Banana fast-0.022/张，sora2-0.08/条，Veo3.1/Veo3.0-0.4/条，Sora image（Gpt4o）-0.02/张，gemini2.5....</span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
</div>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="dck6p-0-0"><span data-offset-key="dck6p-0-0">一个更直观的例子：<span data-offset-key="dck6p-0-1"> 如果你要生成1000张图片：</span></span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="4nmgg-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="4nmgg-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="4nmgg-0-0"><span data-offset-key="4nmgg-0-0">官方成本：0.935元/张 × 1000张 = <span data-offset-key="4nmgg-0-1">935元</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="1u8u7-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="1u8u7-0-0"><span data-offset-key="1u8u7-0-0">GrsAI成本：0.15元/张 × 1000张 = <span data-offset-key="1u8u7-0-1">150元</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="4tfog-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="4tfog-0-0"><span data-offset-key="4tfog-0-0">节省费用：785元</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="afr2b-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="afr2b-0-0"><span data-offset-key="afr2b-0-0">1.获取APikey</span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="3m7h9-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="3m7h9-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="3m7h9-0-0"><span data-offset-key="3m7h9-0-0">访问GrsAI（<a class="Link ztext-link" href="https://grsai.com/" target="_blank" data-offset-key="3m7h9-1-0" data-editable="true" data-draft-title="https://grsai.com" rel="noopener nofollow">https://grsai.com</a><span data-offset-key="3m7h9-2-0">）控制台</span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="942mk-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="942mk-0-0"><span data-offset-key="942mk-0-0">创建API Key</span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="fnjc8-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="fnjc8-0-0"><span data-offset-key="fnjc8-0-0">查看APi接入文档/在线体验</span></div>
</li>
</ul>

<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="d9e55-0-0"><span data-offset-key="d9e55-0-0">2.选择节点</span></div>
</div>
<ul class="public-DraftStyleDefault-ul" data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-0">
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-0"><span data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-0">海外节点<span data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-1">: <span data-offset-key="5tr5m-0-2"><span data-text="true">https://api.grsai.com</span></span></span></span></div>
</li>
<li class="Editable-styled public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="9ogvk-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="9ogvk-0-0"><span data-offset-key="9ogvk-0-0">国内直连<span data-offset-key="9ogvk-0-1">: <span data-offset-key="9ogvk-0-2"><span data-text="true">https://grsai.dakka.com.cn</span></span></span></span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="7220d-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="7220d-0-0"><span data-offset-key="7220d-0-0">3.认证方式</span></div>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="9q8vu-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="9q8vu-0-0"><span data-offset-key="9q8vu-0-0">所有请求需要在Header中添加API Key认证：</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="dqac8-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Authorization: Bearer your_api_key_here</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="ekmnn-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="ekmnn-0-0"><span data-offset-key="ekmnn-0-0">4.图像生成接口基础调用</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="b2j3r-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用国内节点示例</span>
const API_BASE = 'https://grsai.dakka.com.cn'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
const API_KEY </span>= 'your_api_key_here'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> generateImage(prompt, model = 'nano-banana-pro'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
  const response </span>= await fetch(`${API_BASE}/v1/draw/nano-banana`, {
    method: 'POST'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    headers: {
      </span>'Content-Type': 'application/json'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span>'Authorization'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: `Bearer ${API_KEY}`
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: model,
      prompt: prompt,
      aspectRatio: </span>'16:9'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      shutProgress: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    })
  });

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await response.json();
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用示例</span>
generateImage('一只可爱的猫咪在草地上玩耍'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  .then(result </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result.status === 'succeeded'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      console.log(</span>'生成成功:', result.results[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].url);
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      console.log(</span>'生成状态:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.status);
    }
  });</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="Editable-unstyled" data-block="true" data-editor="25u7k" data-offset-key="c2m9f-0-0">
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="c2m9f-0-0"><span data-offset-key="c2m9f-0-0">5.完整参数调用示例</span></div>
</div>
<div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="7mboo-0-0">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const requestBody =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span>"model": "nano-banana-pro", <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 支持的模型: nano-banana-fast, nano-banana, nano-banana-pro</span>
  "prompt": "一只可爱的猫咪在草地上玩耍，阳光明媚，细节丰富，高质量"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span>"aspectRatio": "16:9", <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 支持比例: auto, 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 5:4, 4:5, 21:9</span>
  "urls"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    </span>"https://example.com/reference-image.png" <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 参考图URL数组（选填）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ],
  </span>"webHook": "https://your-domain.com/callback", <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 回调地址（选填）</span>
  "shutProgress": <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否关闭进度回复</span>
};</pre>
</div>
